title: CRAB: Cuboid-based Representation for As-built BIM from Point Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2610.29257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As-built BIM reconstruction from point clouds demands semantic, volumetric, parametric, and editable building components, beyond 2D layouts or planar abstractions. Yet existing scan-to-BIM pipelines often rely on handcrafted rules, heuristic optimization, or manual correction, while learning-based methods fall short of recovering wall thickness, opening geometry, and component-level BIM structure. We introduce CRAB, a BIM-ready cuboid reconstruction framework that encodes walls, doors, windows, beams, and columns as compact architectural cuboids with IFC-compatible semantics and parameters. CRAB bridges point clouds and editable BIM by combining ProposalNet, which predicts coarse component cuboids, with AssemblyNet, a relation-aware Flow Matching model that refines geometry, predicts structural relationships, and enables automatic structural correction and human-guided editing. translated_title: CRAB：基于长方体表示的点云竣工BIM重建方法
translated_abstract: 从点云重建竣工BIM需要语义化、体积化、参数化且可编辑的建筑构件，而不仅仅是二维布局或平面抽象。然而，现有的扫描到BIM（scan-to-BIM）流程通常依赖手工规则、启发式优化或人工修正，而基于学习的方法在恢复墙体厚度、洞口几何形状以及构件级BIM结构方面仍显不足。我们提出了CRAB，一个可直接生成BIM的长方体重建框架，它将墙、门、窗、梁和柱编码为具有IFC兼容语义和参数的紧凑建筑长方体。CRAB通过将预测粗略构件长方体的ProposalNet与关系感知的流匹配模型AssemblyNet相结合，搭建起点云与可编辑BIM之间的桥梁；AssemblyNet能够细化几何形状、预测结构关系，并支持自动结构校正和人工引导编辑。为解决长方体级监督数据有限的问题，我们扩展了Str……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CRAB提出了一种基于长方体表示的点云BIM重建框架，通过ProposalNet与关系感知流匹配模型AssemblyNet相结合，将墙、门、窗、梁、柱等建筑构件转化为具有IFC兼容语义、可编辑的构件级BIM模型。
en_tdlr: CRAB introduces a cuboid-based framework that converts point clouds into editable, IFC-compatible component-level BIM models by combining ProposalNet with AssemblyNet, a relation-aware Flow Matching model that refines geometry and predicts structural relationships.
